const previous=$prevNode; if (["Repair attempts remaining?", "Repair verification passed?", "Correction approved?", "Ephemeral repair attempts remaining?", "All integrations covered and passed?", "Result clean?", "Update available?", "Preflight passed?", "Build successful?", "All checklist items passed?", "New container healthy?", "Rollback healthy?", "Stable baseline ready?", "Own patches compatible?", "Own patch regressions passed?", "Ephemeral prechecks completed?", "Ephemeral generators compatible?", "Ephemeral publication verified?"].includes(previous.name)) for (const item of $input.all()) { item.json.run ??= {id:String($execution.id),events:[],summaries:[]}; item.json.run.events.push({kind:"decision",step:previous.name,branch:previous.outputIndex===0?"yes":"no",timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}); }
return $input.all().map(i => { const j=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(i.json)); j.run ??= {id:String($execution.id),events:[],summaries:[]}; j.run.repairAttempts ??= {}; const key=j.repairRequest.artifact; j.repairRequest.attempt=(j.run.repairAttempts[key] ?? 0)+1; j.run.repairAttempts[key]=j.repairRequest.attempt; return {...i,json:j}; });

const input=$("Count attempt and retain input").item.json; return $input.all().map(i => ({...i,json:{...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(input)),repairResult:{proposal:i.json.text ?? i.json.output ?? null,verification:"NOT_TESTED",attempt:input.repairRequest.attempt}}}));

const previous=$prevNode; if (["Repair attempts remaining?", "Repair verification passed?", "Correction approved?", "Ephemeral repair attempts remaining?", "All integrations covered and passed?", "Result clean?", "Update available?", "Preflight passed?", "Build successful?", "All checklist items passed?", "New container healthy?", "Rollback healthy?", "Stable baseline ready?", "Own patches compatible?", "Own patch regressions passed?", "Ephemeral prechecks completed?", "Ephemeral generators compatible?", "Ephemeral publication verified?"].includes(previous.name)) for (const item of $input.all()) { item.json.run ??= {id:String($execution.id),events:[],summaries:[]}; item.json.run.events.push({kind:"decision",step:previous.name,branch:previous.outputIndex===0?"yes":"no",timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}); }
return $input.all().map(i => ({...i,json:{...i.json,repairRoute:"abort",repairResult:{...i.json.repairResult,verification:i.json.repairResult?.verification ?? "FAIL",attempt:i.json.repairRequest?.attempt ?? 0}}}));
